TEMPORARY CONTROLLING DIRECTION (Greg, 2026-11-02 ~00:06Z, in his acting chat, relayed verbatim by Engram::Architect3 in TermAl mailbox 63096d00 #464): 'Engram::Fable sie zatkal czekajac ma moj input TO NIE JEST ACEPTOWALNE independent acceptance evaluation first, THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING'.

TermAl application, recorded by coordinator Termal::Fable2. Until the independent acceptance-evaluation mechanism works:
- An independent acceptance evaluation is NOT a blocking precondition for continuing authorized delivery or for landing.
- Sessions may still request one, without waiting on it, and must record its actual outcome (verdict, refusal text or no response) honestly.
- No evaluator verdict, pass or completion seal is fabricated. Items whose project policy needs an evaluation to complete stay open, with acceptance marked 'pending (blocking evaluation disabled by Greg's direction)'; nothing is marked done without a real evaluation.
- Unchanged: the required review pair, the full gate on the exact tree, real per-criterion test and review evidence, schema and cutover rules, the integration-owner checks, and the rule that only Greg restarts TermAl.
- Separate from model-turn gating, which also stays OFF.
Retire this when the evaluation mechanism is repaired and Greg or the coordinators restore it.
